# CBC
> Canada’s public broadcaster, offering national and local news, sports coverage, radio, television, podcasts, and streaming video.

CBC.ca is the main digital hub for CBC/Radio-Canada’s English-language services, with extensive coverage of Canadian and international news, live and on-demand sports, radio programs, TV shows, podcasts, and regional reporting. It also connects to CBC Gem for streaming and to topic hubs for politics, business, arts, and investigative journalism.

## Main
- [CBC.ca](https://www.cbc.ca/): Main homepage for CBC news, sports, entertainment, radio, and featured programming.
- [News](https://www.cbc.ca/news): Central news portal covering Canada, world, politics, business, and investigations.
- [Sports](https://www.cbc.ca/sports): Sports hub with scores, analysis, live streams, and event coverage.
- [Radio](https://www.cbc.ca/radio): Entry point for CBC radio shows, schedules, and audio content.
- [Listen](https://www.cbc.ca/listen): Audio destination for live radio, podcasts, and on-demand listening.
- [Television](https://www.cbc.ca/television): TV programming hub with show information, schedules, and related content.
- [CBC Gem](https://gem.cbc.ca/): CBC’s streaming service for live channels and on-demand shows.

## News Sections
- [Canada](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada): National and regional reporting from across Canada.
- [World](https://www.cbc.ca/news/world): International news coverage, analysis, and major global developments.
- [Politics](https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics): Federal politics news, Parliament coverage, and election reporting.
- [Business](https://www.cbc.ca/news/business): Business, economy, markets, consumer, and workplace coverage.
- [Health](https://www.cbc.ca/news/health): Public health, medicine, science, and wellness reporting.
- [Arts](https://www.cbc.ca/news/arts): Arts, culture, media, books, film, and music news.
- [Indigenous](https://www.cbc.ca/news/indigenous): News and features focused on Indigenous communities and issues.
- [Investigates](https://www.cbc.ca/news/investigates): Investigative journalism and in-depth accountability reporting.

## Local News
- [British Columbia](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia): Local and provincial news from British Columbia.
- [Calgary](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/calgary): Local news, weather, and stories from Calgary and southern Alberta.
- [Edmonton](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton): Edmonton-area reporting on local news, politics, and community issues.
- [Saskatchewan](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/saskatchewan): Provincial and local reporting from Saskatchewan.
- [Manitoba](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/manitoba): News and features from Winnipeg and across Manitoba.
- [Toronto](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto): Greater Toronto Area news, transit, housing, and local politics.
- [Montreal](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal): Montreal and Quebec news, culture, and local developments.
- [Nova Scotia](https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/nova-scotia): Local reporting from Halifax and across Nova Scotia.

## Sports
- [Sports Home](https://www.cbc.ca/sports): Main sports page with headlines, video, and live events.
- [Olympics](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/olympics): Olympic news, athlete profiles, schedules, and event coverage.
- [Hockey](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/hockey): Hockey news, NHL coverage, analysis, and highlights.
- [Soccer](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/soccer): Soccer coverage including Canadian and international competitions.
- [Football](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/football): Football news, analysis, and league coverage.
- [Basketball](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/basketball): Basketball reporting, scores, and feature stories.
- [Tennis](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/tennis): Tennis news, tournament coverage, and player updates.
- [Player's Own Voice](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/playersownvoice): First-person essays and stories from athletes.

## Radio & Audio
- [Radio Home](https://www.cbc.ca/radio): Directory of CBC radio programs and audio features.
- [CBC Listen](https://www.cbc.ca/listen): Streaming and on-demand access to CBC radio and podcasts.
- [The Current](https://www.cbc.ca/radio/thecurrent): Daily radio program covering news, ideas, and public affairs.
- [As It Happens](https://www.cbc.ca/radio/asithappens): Weeknight news and interview program with Canadian and global stories.
- [The House](https://www.cbc.ca/radio/thehouse): Weekly political affairs program focused on federal politics.
- [Ideas](https://www.cbc.ca/radio/ideas): Long-form documentary and discussion program on culture and ideas.
- [Quirks & Quarks](https://www.cbc.ca/radio/quirks): Science program covering research, discoveries, and interviews.
- [Front Burner](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/cbc-podcasts/209-front-burner): Daily news podcast with context and analysis.

## Television & Streaming
- [Television Home](https://www.cbc.ca/television): CBC television portal with shows and schedules.
- [CBC Gem](https://gem.cbc.ca/): Streaming platform for CBC shows, films, and live channels.
- [Shows on CBC Gem](https://gem.cbc.ca/shows): Browse CBC Gem series and on-demand programming.
- [Live TV on CBC Gem](https://gem.cbc.ca/live): Live streaming access to CBC channels and events.
- [The National](https://www.cbc.ca/news/thenational): CBC’s flagship nightly news program with video and segments.
- [Marketplace](https://www.cbc.ca/news/marketplace): Consumer investigative program with stories, episodes, and tips.
- [Fifth Estate](https://www.cbc.ca/fifth): Investigative documentary program with episodes and reporting.
- [Docs](https://gem.cbc.ca/collection/docs): Documentary collection available on CBC Gem.

## Podcasts
- [CBC Podcasts](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/cbc-podcasts): Directory of CBC podcast series across news and culture.
- [Front Burner](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/cbc-podcasts/209-front-burner): Daily news podcast explaining major Canadian stories.
- [Someone Knows Something](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/cbc-podcasts/128-someone-knows-something): Investigative true-crime podcast hosted by David Ridgen.
- [The Dose](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/cbc-podcasts/410-the-dose): Weekly health and wellness podcast answering audience questions.
- [Uncover](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/cbc-podcasts/47-uncover): Investigative podcast series exploring crime, corruption, and hidden stories.
- [The Next Chapter](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/live-radio/1-63-the-next-chapter): Books and author interviews from CBC Radio.
- [Because News](https://www.cbc.ca/listen/cbc-podcasts/173-because-news): Weekly news quiz and comedy panel podcast.

## Programs & Features
- [The National](https://www.cbc.ca/news/thenational): Nightly news program with top stories, interviews, and video.
- [Marketplace](https://www.cbc.ca/news/marketplace): Consumer affairs investigations and audience-submitted tips.
- [The Fifth Estate](https://www.cbc.ca/fifth): Long-running investigative journalism television program.
- [The Nature of Things](https://www.cbc.ca/natureofthings): Science and nature documentary series hosted on CBC platforms.
- [Still Standing](https://www.cbc.ca/television/stillstanding): Comedy-doc series visiting small communities across Canada.
- [Heartland](https://www.cbc.ca/television/heartland): Family drama series information, episodes, and extras.
- [Murdoch Mysteries](https://www.cbc.ca/television/murdochmysteries): Period detective series with show details and updates.
- [Dragons' Den](https://www.cbc.ca/television/dragonsden): Business reality series featuring entrepreneur pitches and judges.

## About & Help
- [About CBC](https://www.cbc.ca/aboutcbc): Corporate overview of CBC’s mandate and organization.
- [Corrections and Clarifications](https://cbc.radio-canada.ca/en/ombudsman/corrections-clarifications): Published corrections and clarifications from CBC.
- [Ombudsman](https://cbc.radio-canada.ca/en/ombudsman): Standards accountability office handling journalistic complaints and reviews.
- [Accessibility](https://www.cbc.ca/accessibility/): Information about CBC accessibility services and commitments.
- [Help Centre](https://cbchelp.cbc.ca/): Support for CBC accounts, CBC Gem, and digital products.
- [Contact CBC](https://cbchelp.cbc.ca/hc/en-ca/requests/new): Contact form for support and audience inquiries.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.cbc.ca/terms-of-use): Terms governing use of CBC digital services.
- [Privacy](https://www.cbc.ca/privacy): Privacy policy for CBC websites, apps, and services.
